comparisons.peer_summary: The company provides an extensive portfolio of silicon and software products, including CPUs and accelerators, supported by a software development environment that enables workload mobility across heterogeneous architectures.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Intel disclosed that their hardware strategies are supported by comprehensive software ecosystems designed to optimize performance for specific workloads. AMD stated that it consolidated AI teams to drive the development of a 'comprehensive software ecosystem' and improved its ROCm software to increase performance in generative AI workloads. Intel described providing an 'extensive portfolio of silicon and software products' and a 'software development environment' that enables workload mobility across its heterogeneous architectures, including accelerators. Both companies emphasize that their competitive advantage relies on the integration of specialized hardware (AMD's Instinct accelerators, Intel's accelerators/CPUs) with tailored software environments to meet customer demands in high-performance computing.

sentences.text: To execute our AI strategy, we brought together multiple AI teams across AMD to drive development of a comprehensive software ecosystem spanning our full product portfolio.

We made several key optimizations and introduced new features in the latest AMD ROCm™ software that increased performance in key generative AI workloads, expanded support and optimization for additional frameworks and libraries, and simplified the overall developer experience.
We provide our customers with an extensive portfolio of silicon and software products, engineered to deliver workload-optimized performance.

Deployment of our silicon platforms is accelerated by a software development environment that enables workload mobility across our heterogeneous architectures and enables developers to execute their workloads on the hardware that best meets application requirements.

comparisons.peer_topic: Data Center revenue and AI platform launches
comparisons.peer_summary: Data Center revenue for fiscal year 2024 was $47.5 billion, up 217% from fiscal year 2023, with approximately 40% attributed to AI inference. The company launched AI inference platforms, NVIDIA DGX Cloud, AI Foundations, and Spectrum-X to support generative AI and accelerated networking.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and NVIDIA disclosed specific strategic actions to expand their AI software ecosystems and accelerate model development in 2024. AMD described bringing together multiple AI teams to drive a comprehensive software ecosystem and explicitly acquiring Silo AI Oy to accelerate the training of large language models (LLMs) on AMD hardware. Similarly, NVIDIA highlighted the launch of its AI inference platforms and the introduction of NVIDIA DGX Cloud and AI Foundations, which are services specifically designed to help businesses create and operate custom LLMs and generative AI models. While AMD focused on an acquisition to build its software stack, NVIDIA focused on launching cloud-based services and software platforms to support the same emerging technology of LLMs.

sentences.text: To execute our AI strategy, we brought together multiple AI teams across AMD to drive development of a comprehensive software ecosystem spanning our full product portfolio.
We also made strategic investments to further expand our AI software capabilities with the acquisition of Silo AI Oy (Silo AI), an AI lab based in Finland.

In Data Center, we launched AI inference platforms that combine our full-stack inference software with NVIDIA Ada, NVIDIA Hopper and NVIDIA Grace Hopper processors optimized for generative AI, LLMs and other AI workloads.
We introduced NVIDIA DGX Cloud and AI Foundations to help businesses create and operate custom large language models and generative AI models.
